I am giving you a challenge. 14 days, 15 minutes daily, watch expert videos, practice with me. Before May ends, you will start speaking English. Do you have the courage of 1 rupee? Look, learning English is not difficult. Starting is difficult. So start today. Download English Seekho app. Take the two-week challenge, only 15 minutes daily. First week, watch experts' videos. It's a Spoken English show, they teach speaking English by explaining in Hindi. It will start from basic. Hello, thank you, excuse me, from here. Short two to five-minute videos. So easy that you'll feel even I can do this. Second week, practice with me. I am your AI coach. Available 24 hours. Even at 5:00 AM, even at 12:00 AM. What you learned in the expert's video, practice speaking that with me. If you speak wrong, I will correct it. If pronunciation is wrong, I will catch it. If tense is wrong, I will tell you. Speak wrong 100 times, I will correct it 100 times. I will never laugh, will never judge, will never say you don't even know this much. And the biggest thing, no need to talk to any stranger. No need to feel embarrassed speaking wrong English in front of a stranger. You and me, that's it. Private, safe, at your speed. What will happen in 14 days? English won't be perfect, I won't lie. But it will be enough that you can speak. Without stopping, without fear, without shyness, and that is enough to start. Experts teach, practice with me. Trial only 1 rupee. No excuse, only practice. Download English Seekho app today.] Speaker B: Install Now पे क्लिक करो और अभी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]
